paragraphs: Chapter 740
Episode 184. Overcoming Destiny (12)
The group immediately pointed their swords in all directions.
The monster was not in sight. Only its gloomy voice, which vibrated the vast darkness, continued.
[What did it say to you? That petty, long curse was clearly conveyed to me due to my resentment towards me, but I couldn't hear the rest.]
Jin stared at the void.
"Do monsters need to know what humans say to each other?"
[So you're saying, you felt this impurity separated from me as a human?]
"At least, it was much closer to a human than you."
[Heh, I don't know what you talked about, but it seems the impurity that was my last humanity shook your heart. I see you're aware of this body as soon as my voice started to sound......]
"You're jumping to conclusions. Stop talking and reveal your shape...."
Suddenly!
The moment Jin said this, the body of the young Rosa was torn to shreds, with flesh and bone fragments flying around.
The reason was that the soul energy tied to the body inflated rapidly.
As the monster said, Jin had felt a strange emotion from his short encounter with the young Rosa.
What if she had kept that pure and strong heart and become his mother, if she hadn't become a monster, what would have happened... He felt such thoughts.
Could that be why?
Jin was greatly shocked by the sight of the young Rosa's body being torn apart without form before his eyes.
Although he didn't show it on the outside, he couldn't fool the monster.
[Oh dear, is it hard to see? If you had accepted the gift I wanted to give you last time, you wouldn't have had to feel such useless emotions...]
It was a story about the preliminary battle between Jin and Rosa in the underworld.
The body of the young Rosa was torn apart without even a shape remaining, and the multiplied soul energy even swallowed the body fragments that fell all around.
Then, the soul energy started to take a certain shape.
A large, dark figure was being formed in an instant.
It was similar to a beast walking on four legs.
Evil eyes emitting red light, claws and teeth larger than a human torso, and dark fur that seemed to suck all light. It looked very similar to a fierce beast that existed in the world.
Black Leopard.
This nickname used to symbolize Rosa in her human days.
The creature, panting heavily, looked down at the group.
Facing the Black Leopard's eyes, Jin smirked.

"Now that you've thrown away your last humanity, is it time to throw away the nickname you were called in the past? I get a strange feeling that you're attached to your human days. I wonder if you're unconsciously doing these bizarre things because you regret becoming a monster after falling into depravity."
[If there's one thing I regret, it's that I empowered Joshua instead of you. If I had recognized your true nature from the beginning...]
The monster uttered the last part indistinctly and let out a strange laugh for a while.
And after about ten seconds, the monster's voice was no longer heard. Instead, the Black Leopard moved its large figure, casting a shadow.
[Growl...]
The Black Leopard slowly circled around, keeping its gaze on the group.
Despite its body, heavier than a dragon, moving, there was no sound of its footsteps.
The situation wasn't good. Because of the fierce battle with the previous generation leaders just a moment ago, most of the group were in a state of severe injury.
Among the group, only Jin and Bianca could exert their usual, or similar to usual, power.
Especially Octavia was in a state where she couldn't participate in the fight at all.
Once the battle started, the group had to protect her and the unidentified previous generation leader who lost consciousness.
So the group contemplated how to respond for a moment, but Jin had already decided his approach.
"Bianca, you protect our allies."
Jin intended to face the Black Leopard alone.
"Alone... to fight?"
"Yes."
"That... we don't know... how strong it is. It could be dangerous."
"If you think I'm in danger, then help me."
"Um... okay."
Bianca wanted to persuade him to reconsider, but she stopped after seeing Jin's eyes.
Even she felt a chill down her spine, such was the intense aura he was exuding.
His anger towards the monster and the resentment from having to fight disadvantageously while trying to save the previous generation leaders was about to explode all at once.
"Crush it."
The moment Jin said in a low voice, the Black Leopard started its attack first.
Its front paw distorted space as it descended over Jin's head.
Jin didn't avoid it but received it head-on.
The shock wave spread, and the ground sank in a large semicircle.
But what the paw struck was not Jin, but the ground.
Just before the paw touched, Jin sidestepped, taking a step with his sword.
The stroke he swung then left a sword trace above the Black Leopard's paused front paw.
A ridiculously long and straight line, as if the entire space had been cut in that instant.
After a moment, the afterimage disappeared, and something heavy fell from the Black Leopard, rolling on the ground.
Thud!
What fell to the ground was the right front paw of the Black Leopard that had just swung at Jin.
[Roar!]
The fallen paw melted like water, creating a sticky puddle of spirit energy.
Originally, the severed part should have regenerated instantly, but Bradamante had already been soaked in the blurry eternity.
The Black Leopard's phantom tried to regenerate without rest, but the speed was slow due to the adhering eternity.
[Growl... Roar!]
The Black Leopard swung its remaining left paw to push Jin away.
But Jin sliced that in one shot as well, his eyes widening in surprise.
Once again, the Black Leopard's paw fell to the ground, making a heavy noise.
The Black Leopard, now without its front paws, couldn't find its balance properly.
It was clear that Jin had the overwhelming advantage in simple close-quarters combat within two moves.
That was something neither the Black Leopard nor the allies had anticipated.
Of course, the allies thought Jin would have the upper hand, but they didn't expect him to overpower that monster so easily.
'The monster wouldn't have just created this creature to defile the young Rosa's corpse. There must be some element that could pose a threat.'
Jin's eyes landed on the Black Leopard's fallen paws.
Puddles made of sticky, black spirit energy were seen bubbling, like a solution with a strong acidity.
'Is the ground being eaten away?'
So far, descending into the inner world, Jin and his group had kept some facts about this space in mind.
First, as Alpen said, once you go down, you can't go back up, and the internal structure constantly changes.
Also, it is nearly impossible to completely destroy the sub-space made up of spirit energy like an ordinary building.
If that were possible, they would have just destroyed everything and headed underground without having to face the enemies guarding each floor like gatekeepers.
But the puddles left by the melting body of the Black Leopard were different.
It was melting the wall of spirit energy that Jin's spirit sword couldn't even penetrate, like sugar.
So, Jin paused his attack for a moment and examined the puddle.

The Black Leopard regenerated its front paws in the meantime, but they weren't in perfect shape. The phantom had regenerated in a grotesque form with barely a skeleton left, and eternity was flaring in the cracks.
Crash, Crack-!
The Black Leopard, beating Jin with its front paws again, screamed each time it moved due to the pain of eternity.
Jin purposely only avoided the attacks. He felt he should not hastily slice the creature before finding out the effect of the puddle.
The only problem was that eternity had already caused a crack in the creature's regenerated area.
Even if the Black Leopard just swung its front paw, the crack widened, and its flesh and bones, or something like that, were flying all over.
Just like the first fallen paws, all of these melted the ground.
Already, dozens of large holes were opened near Jin and the Black Leopard.
Inside them, the bottomless abyss that they saw every time they descended to the lower levels was spread out.
Like burning paper, the holes created in the ground kept expanding.
Only a few seconds had passed, but the holes had already expanded near our allies who had retreated behind.
The nature of the hole was unknown. Whether it's a hole leading to the lower levels of the underworld, or a trap that should not be fallen into.
One thing was certain, falling into that hole was something the evil god desired.
Therefore, Jin thought to stop the battle and run to a space where holes hadn't formed with his allies, but there was already a chasm formed between him and his allies that couldn't be jumped over.
'When on earth did this happen?'
With each passing second, the eternal flame attached to the black panther grew larger.
It no longer looked like a black panther, but more like a lump of flesh engulfed in blue fire.
As it moved, bits of its flesh melted the space between Jin and his allies in an instant.
'From the beginning, the black panther wasn't created for battle. The evil god expected me to use the eternal flame immediately and prepared this trap...!'
In other words, this situation was the evil god's trap and warning against the 'Eternal Flame'.
If you continue to use the eternal flame against him and his army, a more dire situation could unfold. A warning that they might fall.
For now, Jin created a path with his freezing magic and ran towards his allies.
If the ground collapses at this speed, there would be no way to avoid falling.
So, it was better to stick with his allies.
"Catch!"
As Jin crossed the last icy path, he barely caught the hand reached out by Hedo.
But by then, more than 90% of the ground had already melted away. Even the black panther, who had been chasing Jin, had already fallen below and was no longer visible.
In the end, the group had no choice but to hold onto each other and wait for the fall.
"Don't let go of each other's hands when we fall. If this leads to the lower levels, we could get separated by just letting go for a moment."
As his allies nodded in response to Alpen's words, the last remaining ground collapsed, and they started to fall.
Thud...!
Unlike before, the fall ended in an instant.
As soon as they hit the ground, the group checked to make sure they were all holding hands, and sighed with relief.
But as soon as they looked around, they had to realize it wasn't a situation to be relieved.
"...How many of them are there?"
Black panthers were swarming all around. At a glance, it seemed like there were hundreds of them.
The black panther that had fallen with the group was visible in the center.
And it was transferring the eternal flame clinging to it to other black panthers, like spreading an infectious disease.
The group naturally imagined what would happen next.
All those black panthers would begin to melt the ground by succumbing to the eternal flame.
If they couldn't stop it, there was only one thing to expect.
An endless fall.
